raw_response: {"diagnosis":"80 raw_transactions rows are in EUR, but silver_transactions loads `amount` unconverted, so EUR amounts are summed as if they were USD in every gold table. raw_fx_rates has exactly one rate per currency (EUR=1.25), so the rows can be converted to USD in silver.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON upper(trim(t.currency)) = upper(trim(f.currency)) WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
